en.metaDesc: 24/7 bilingual AI phone answering, website chat, and CRM automation for Central Texas small businesses. From $299/mo plus $199 setup. Built and maintained in Waco.
en.intro: A missed call is a customer calling the next name on the list. If you're on a roof, under a truck, or in a kitchen, you can't answer — and an answering machine loses the job just as reliably as ringing out. We set up an AI agent that picks up every time, in English or Spanish, takes the details, books the appointment, and texts you the lead before you've climbed down.

sections.p: It answers with your business name, asks what the caller needs, handles the common questions — hours, service area, rough pricing, whether you do that kind of job — and either books a time or takes a message. When it hits something it doesn't know, it says so and takes a message instead of guessing. We'd rather it hand you a clean lead than improvise an answer that costs you the job.

The $199 setup is where we sit down and teach it your business: services, prices, service area, hours, the questions you're tired of answering, and the ones you want routed straight to your phone. After launch you'll catch things it handled badly. Send them over — tuning is included in the monthly, and the first month is where most of it happens.

This is not a replacement for you. It's a replacement for voicemail. It's good at intake, scheduling, and answering the same eight questions forever. It is not good at negotiating, quoting complex jobs, or handling an upset customer — those get routed to you, on purpose. Anyone selling it as more than that is selling you something.

Los $199 de instalación son donde nos sentamos a enseñarle tu negocio: servicios, precios, zona de servicio, horarios, las preguntas que ya estás cansado de contestar y las que quieres que te pasen directo al teléfono. Después del lanzamiento vas a notar cosas que manejó mal. Mándanoslas — los ajustes van incluidos en la mensualidad, y el primer mes es cuando ocurren casi todos.

Esto no te reemplaza a ti. Reemplaza a la contestadora. Es bueno para tomar datos, agendar y contestar las mismas ocho preguntas para siempre. No es bueno para negociar, cotizar trabajos complicados ni atender a un cliente molesto — eso se te pasa a ti, a propósito. Quien te lo venda como algo más te está vendiendo humo.

Listings get an establishing shot that shows the lot, the street, and what's around it — the things a ground-level photo can't. For construction, we fly the same angles on a schedule so the progress sequence actually lines up frame to frame instead of looking like three unrelated shoots.

sections.h: Where we can and can't fly
sections.p: Waco has controlled airspace near the regional airport, and TSTC has its own. Those flights need LAANC authorization, which we request — it's usually approved in minutes, occasionally denied. We'll tell you before you book if your address sits somewhere that's going to be a problem, rather than showing up and finding out.

sections.p: Screens are RGB; presses are CMYK. A bright orange that glows on your laptop prints muddy brown, and a file without bleed comes back with a white sliver on one edge. We build files in the right color space with the right margins, so what you unbox matches what you approved.

We keep your print files. When you run out of cards or want another 500 flyers with a new phone number, it's a message and a small change fee — not a fresh design charge and another week of back-and-forth.
